_label: FIXTURE: hand-written by the developers for tests and for running without an API key. This is NOT model output.

regions.name: heavy_slippery
regions.rationale: Heavy slippery cubes need more friction force than a light grip provides.

regions.name: slow_gripper_small_cube
regions.rationale: High actuation latency lets the lift start before small cubes are gripped.

regions.name: noisy_perception
regions.rationale: Large position noise makes the fingers land on the cube or grasp it off-centre.

regions.name: far_offsets
regions.rationale: Cubes near the edge of the workspace stress the approach geometry.
